Version 0.4.0

- Added support for --mt4-terminal and --mt5-terminal options to compile with a user-supplied portable terminal and its standard library.
- Updated documentation to describe changes in installation, platform selection, and option usage.
- Removed the skill-card.md file.

- Removed the file: skill-card.md
- No other changes to functionality or documentation.

- Removed the file: skill-card.md
- No changes to functionality or documentation; this update only deletes a file.

mql-compiler v0.3.0

- Added support for command-line options: `-I/--include` to add extra include folders, `--werror`, `--watch`, output formatting, `--setup`, `--update`, and improved `--version` details.
- Includes outside the MQL4/MQL5 tree can now be specified via `-I`, changing include resolution order and allowing shared include folders.
- Compiler output is now in JSON Lines format by default, with structured fields for errors, warnings, and results; plain text output is no longer default.
- Compile status, errors, and warnings are now reported with more precise data (including line, column, and code) in machine-readable form.
- Previous plain text examples and instructions have been updated to show the new JSON interface and options.
- Removed deprecated sample file: skill-card.md.

- Added explicit support and limitation notes for x86-64 (amd64) only; clarified that ARM is not supported.
- Installation, compilation, file handling, and include resolution documentation improved for accuracy and completeness.
- Expanded explanation of path, folder, and symlink handling, including skips and error cases.
- Clarified exit codes, error logging, and access to logs from previous runs.
- Removed deprecated skill-card.md file.

- Arguments can now be absolute or relative paths to files/folders, anywhere on the machine. No need to change directory before compiling.
- Standard library and user Include folders are merged in-memory per run; user files override standard ones by path.
- Improved handling and documentation of how `#include` and `#resource` resolve.
- Ownership of output files set to the caller.
- Compilation process clarified: files compile one after another in path order; each compiles only once even if listed multiple times.
- Removed obsolete `skill-card.md` file.

- Added a new installation reference guide at references/installation.md.
- Updated install instructions in SKILL.md to direct users to the new reference for system-wide installs, upgrades, uninstalling, custom installers, and troubleshooting.

- Improved SKILL.md documentation for usage, installation, and output of mql-compiler.
- Clarified how to invoke mql-compiler and interpret its results.
- Provided specific instructions and agent usage rules for reliable operation.
- Expanded troubleshooting details, exit codes, and environment configuration options.
